# Abdullah Al Arif — AI Engineer

> AI Engineer specializing in RAG systems, agentic AI, LLM fine-tuning, and scalable MLOps infrastructure. Based in Bangladesh. Available for remote work and consulting.

## About

Abdullah Al Arif is an AI Engineer with 1.5+ years of experience building production-grade AI systems. He specializes in architecting retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, autonomous agentic workflows, and scalable MLOps infrastructure. His approach is grounded in first principles: trace the math before trusting the framework, benchmark before optimizing, and evaluate before deploying.

At Fluvo Soft, Abdullah builds agentic AI systems from the ground up — designing multi-agent architectures with LangGraph, integrating MCP for tool access, and structuring workflows for production-level autonomy.

Previously at Software Intelligence Ltd, he built production RAG pipelines that served real users, reduced hallucination through Pydantic citation enforcement and cross-encoder reranking, and integrated MCP and A2A protocols end-to-end.

## Expertise

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with hybrid retrieval and cross-encoder reranking
- Agentic AI and multi-agent systems using LangGraph and CrewAI
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol integration
- LLM fine-tuning with QLoRA and PEFT
- LLM Evaluation with Ragas, LLM-as-judge, and hallucination detection
- GraphRAG and hybrid search (vector + BM25)
- MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, ZenML, FastAPI
- Vector databases: FAISS, ChromaDB, Pinecone, pgvector
- Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn
- Prompt engineering and evaluation
- AWS SageMaker, GitHub Actions

## Key Projects

- **Production RAG Assistant** (62 GitHub stars): Production-grade RAG research assistant using hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and citation enforcement for grounded answers from research papers.
- **ProjectSmith AI**: Multi-agent workflow that stress-tests startup ideas and generates phased project plans with costs and downloadable PRD.
- **Reformer from Scratch**: Clean PyTorch reimplementation of the Reformer (ICLR 2020) with LSH Attention, Reversible Layers, and Chunked FFNs.
- **CNN From Scratch**: CNN implemented from scratch using NumPy, trained on MNIST achieving ~85% accuracy.
- **LLM Fine-Tuning Pipeline**: QLoRA fine-tuning pipeline for GPT-2 Medium with 4-bit NF4 and LoRA on attention layers.
